limitations: All model/route identifiers advertised by the configured Magpie catalogue are attempted, including routing groups; this does not mean every upstream accepts requests.
One screening attempt per model and round; upstream load and caching uncontrolled. Application cache disabled.
Two different providers may be screened concurrently; routing groups run alone. Each translation attempt has a 45-second total deadline.
Failure or timeout is not a completed translation latency. Presence of Chinese, complete item counts, links and format checks do not establish full linguistic quality.
Original-format browser run includes scheduling, provider calls and DOM rendering, excludes page/browser startup. No direct timing comparison with the reference commercial service was performed.

markerReductionHistoricalNativeProtocol.scope: Input character and marker counts only; not model token counts or latency.
